name: Full Circle
source:
Full Circle is about Melville Thatcher, renowned campus man-whore, and his quest for a job, an apartment, and another lay.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=5634]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
《Full Circle》讲述校园知名花花公子梅尔维尔·撒切尔寻找工作、住处和下一段艳遇的故事。

[译自 [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=5634]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
